description: The shared Renovate preset of the repositories of dan-petty: the schedule, the groups, the labels, the reviewers, the commit messages, the vulnerability alerts and the automerge of each update after all checks pass. A repository extends it with github>dan-petty/infra//renovate/base. A repository with Kubernetes manifests under k8s/ also extends github>dan-petty/infra//renovate/k8s.

packageRules.description: Non-major updates come in one pull request for each ecosystem, on the schedule.
A patch release holds bug and security fixes, so it comes at once, in its own patch-<group> branch.

Owner, 2026-11-20 (#6547), 2026-11-23 (#50) and 2026-11-23 (#52): each update merges itself after all of its checks pass. Renovate merges the pull request on a later run, and only when each check of the pull request passed, so the rule needs no ruleset. GitHub auto-merge is off here: it waits only for the checks that a ruleset requires, and some repositories require none. A group branch merges only when each update in it can merge, so digest is in the rule: the groups github actions and container images hold digest updates.
These images publish several tags a day, so even a patch waits for the schedule.
A new Python minor or major is a migration of the runtime. The Dependency Dashboard lists it until a person or an agent approves it when the stack supports it.
A major of the Node runtime or of a data service needs a migration, so it also waits for an approval on the Dependency Dashboard.

An image with a registry host is named by the last two parts of its reference, and a digest update leaves out the tag, so the title stays within 60 characters. The rule of the devcontainer features comes after this rule and replaces its name.
An action dependency names itself without the word action, so the title stays within 60 characters.
A feature is named by the last part of its reference, so the title stays within 60 characters.

A version input of an action, such as the version of setup-uv, names a release tag and has no place for a digest. Renovate cannot write a digest pin of it (update failure), so only the action references and the images pin a digest.

Each manager names infra in its own form: dan-petty/infra (a workflow), github.com/dan-petty/infra, https://github.com/dan-petty/infra or https://github.com/dan-petty/infra.git (a remote, a source, the copier template). The title takes the name, so each form gets the one name dan-petty/infra and the title stays within 60 characters. The rule changes only the title: the lookups still read the name of the manager.
The copier update of the repository template gets its own title, so that it differs from the update of the other pins of infra of the same release.
